_meta.definition: The unifying capability across all tables is the management of marketing campaigns, including promotion details, channel management, and customer interaction.

columns.name: p_promo_sk
columns.description: Stores sequential identifiers for individual promotions.

columns.name: p_promo_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the p_promo_ entity

columns.name: p_start_date_sk
columns.description: Stores sequential integer keys for promotion start dates.

columns.name: p_end_date_sk
columns.description: Stores sequential integer keys for the end dates of promotions.

columns.name: p_item_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for items associated with promotions.

columns.name: p_cost
columns.description: Stores the fixed cost for each promotion event.

columns.name: p_response_target
columns.description: Stores a binary indicator for promotion response targets consistently meeting their goals (1 = met).

columns.name: p_promo_name
columns.description: Stores short, alphabetic names for promotions, such as 'ought', 'able', 'pri', 'ese', and 'anti'.

columns.name: p_channel_dmail
columns.description: Stores whether a promotion was distributed via direct email marketing (Y) or not (N).

columns.name: p_channel_email
columns.description: Stores email addresses for promotions distributed via email channels.

columns.name: p_channel_catalog
columns.description: Stores a channel identifier for catalog promotion offers.

columns.name: p_channel_tv
columns.description: Stores the promotion medium as 'N', indicating television channel.

columns.name: p_channel_radio
columns.description: Stores promotion channel type, consistently set to 'N' for non-internet sales.

columns.name: p_channel_press
columns.description: Stores promotion channel type for press media.

columns.name: p_channel_event
columns.description: Stores promotional event type for each occurrence, consistently set to 'N' in these samples.

columns.name: p_channel_demo
columns.description: Stores promotional channel demonstration codes, all samples are 'N'.

columns.name: p_channel_details
columns.description: Stores descriptive text for various promotional channels in a diplomatic and often metaphorical manner.
samples: Men will not say merely. Old, available
At all rich attempts achieve possible, certain mat
Clothes channel diplomatic, other women. Selecti

columns.name: p_purpose
columns.description: Stores purpose type for promotions (e.g., Unknown).

columns.name: p_discount_active
columns.description: Indicates whether a promotion is currently active (N denotes inactive).
